---
name: Suggest a pack
about: A bundle you would like to exist, that you are not writing yourself
title: '[idea] '

**What the pack would install**:

**Who it is for** — what are they doing on the box that the existing packs do not cover?

**Anything about it that looks hard** — an installer that prompts, a tool with no arm64 build, a
step that cannot easily be made safe to re-run. Naming these up front is the most useful part of
a suggestion, because they are what decides whether the pack can pass the checks at all.
